title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.9
subtitle: Steadier Live View and expanded Cloth rest shapes.

highlights.title: Reliable Live View
highlights.description: Live playback holds the last complete cloth frame until the next PC2 frame is fully available, avoiding occasional one-frame jumps.

highlights.title: Final Playback Preserved
highlights.description: Completed Bakes keep their normal playback interpolation, while live and multi-object previews stay synchronized to confirmed frames.

highlights.title: Negative Shrink
highlights.description: Negative Cloth Shrink expands the rest shape for pre-stretch. Cloth NeXt flags a conflicting Stretch Limit before Bake.

highlights.title: Smooth Toolbar
highlights.description: F6 slides the New Look toolbar below the viewport edge and brings it back smoothly.
